part.text:
From source we pluck the tokens, one by one,
And feed them to the parser's strict machine,
Where grammar spins its tree beneath the sun
Of syntax, ordered, branching, evergreen.
We walk the branches, checking every type,
Then optimize the fat away with greed,
Unrolling loops, dead code put out of sight,
Till cycles shrink to what the silicon needs.
At last the code emits, address by address,
Assembly whispering what source once meant —
Two languages, one truth, more or less,
Translated whole, and linked without lament.
